proves.claim: The timeline reads a gate_settled event's outcome and class and labels the wait after a main-red or stale-base settle MAIN_RED or STALE_BASE.

stats.timeline.gate-settled-class.why: Without it time lost to a red main or a stale base is counted as the builder's rework.

proves.claim: A gate job with no gate_settled event keeps the step-derived reason, class null and the rework bucket.

stats.timeline.gate-settled-absent-uncha.why: Without it boards from before the event would read differently.
